About Us:

Mental Pain and Trauma Centers is a leading provider of comprehensive psychological services, dedicated to supporting individuals coping with personal injury trauma. Our team of professionals is committed to delivering high-quality assessments and evaluations to ensure quality of service and direction of the psychotherapy treatment plan.

Job Description:

We are currently seeking a skilled and empathetic PSYPACT-licensed Psychological Evaluator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for conducting thorough psychological assessments for individuals involved in personal injury cases. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in trauma-focused evaluations and be capable of providing insightful and comprehensive reports. The evaluator will not be doing psychotherapy. This position is completely remote.

Responsibilities:

Conduct in-depth psychological assessments for clients involved in personal injury cases.
Administer and interpret psychological tests to evaluate the impact of trauma on individuals
Provide evidence-based recommendations for treatment and intervention strategies.
Compile detailed and comprehensive reports summarizing evaluation findings.
Testify in court as an expert witness when required.
Stay current on the latest research and developments in the field of trauma psychology.

Qualifications

Doctoral degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) in Clinical Psychology from an APA-accredited program.
PSYPACT licensing
Experience in conducting psychological evaluations.
Strong knowledge of trauma-focused assessment tools.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.

Job Types: Part-time, Contract

Pay: $125.00 - $200.00 per hour

Do you possess a PhD in clinical psychology or a PsyD?
